meta.title: The Five Koshas — Knowledge Graph
meta.subtitle: Concept map of a four-session TTC-300 series · Satchidananda · Uruguay 2026
built_from: 20260623-koshas-ttc-300-uruguay/ (Session 4 — transcript + notes from the recording wXDXmb4MMR0)
meta.method: LLM-authored by reasoning over the session notes/transcripts (stage-2 curation of the auto-extractor output), not hand-written — see artifacts/koshas-graph/pipeline/.

nodes.label: Annamaya
nodes.desc: Physical / 'food' layer. Anna = food. External skin-muscle-bone + internal organs-fluids-nerves. Reframed as an entropy-resisting energy-conversion system. The first interface for feeling.

nodes.label: Pranamaya
nodes.desc: Energetic / vital-force layer. Tied to the nadis and nervous system. Reframed as 'state transition' (the gearbox). Fluid; reaches hundreds of metres.

nodes.label: Manomaya
nodes.desc: Mental layer. Manu = mind. Lower mind (perception, memory, cognition) vs higher mind (intellect, viveka, reflection). Reframed as attention management.

nodes.label: Vijnanamaya
nodes.desc: Wisdom / intuition / knowledge body. Reframed as pattern recognition; gateway to collective consciousness and expanded vision. The realm of prayer and the akashic library.

nodes.label: Anandamaya
nodes.desc: Bliss body. Ananda = bliss; also the uniform, pure, unchanging. Reframed as baseline coherence / non-duality. Effectively infinite; the potential the others emerge from. Reached via willpower & causal introspection.

nodes.label: Kosha
nodes.desc: Sheath / covering / 'the space of a layer'. The five koshas are the organizing framework of the whole series — a flexible lens, not a fixed doctrine.

nodes.label: Framework, not doctrine
nodes.desc: The koshas offered as an alternative presentation alongside the traditional — students are asked to argue with it, refine it, make it their own.

nodes.label: Rotating awareness
nodes.desc: Settling = scanning body → energy → mind → breath, a portable 'rotation' through the koshas. Without genuine sensing it degrades into empty ritual.

nodes.label: Modern-science reframe
nodes.desc: Each kosha re-described in contemporary/scientific language — the heart of Session 1.

nodes.label: Self → Others
nodes.desc: Sensitizing to one's own koshas is the ground for sensitizing to others. 'Be the change'; 'don't teach what you haven't touched.'

nodes.label: Integration & hand-off
nodes.desc: The closing arc of the final session: draw the four sessions together (framework → connection → philosophy/sound → willpower/integration), then 'you're on your own to discover and to share back to the whole world.' Scanned and integrated as one table.

nodes.label: Teacher's craft
nodes.desc: Reading a room and a student layer by layer, with minimal projection; choosing the practice for the kosha state in front of you.

nodes.label: Drashta (the observer)
nodes.desc: The witness/observer — grounded in one's own practice so as to read others with minimal projection or guessing.

nodes.label: Prana
nodes.desc: Life-force / vital energy. Sources, retention, and leak-points. 'Prana is life' — all life responds to sound because it is tied to prana.

nodes.label: Nadis
nodes.desc: Subtle energy channels. 'A nadi is a river of prana' (in Nepali a river is a nadi).

nodes.label: Awareness
nodes.desc: The faculty directed fluidly among the koshas. 'Where was my attention today?' The monk extends awareness into another's body — 'like their body is my body.'

nodes.label: Attention management
nodes.desc: The manomaya reframe. Suffering often traces to where attention was over long periods, not just external causes.

nodes.label: Emotion
nodes.desc: 'Energy in motion connected to meaning.' Crosses all koshas — a phenomenon that arises and moves through them. Emotional balance is an advanced attainment.

nodes.label: Entropy & cohesion
nodes.desc: The force that dissolves everything; the body is a miracle of holding cohesion against entropy. The annamaya reframe.

nodes.label: State transition
nodes.desc: The pranamaya reframe — capacity to shift between situations / emotional landscapes on demand (the gearbox).

nodes.label: Pattern recognition
nodes.desc: The vijnanamaya reframe — recognizing recurring threads → expanded vision, imagination, empathy. Root of yoga, Ayurveda, all sciences.

nodes.label: Baseline coherence
nodes.desc: The anandamaya reframe — the felt state when all systems run in harmony; peace is intrinsic, uncovered rather than added.

nodes.label: Property: Scale
nodes.desc: Each kosha is orders of magnitude larger than the prior: body ~2 m; prana hundreds of metres; mind across time/space; vijnanamaya all-that-can-be-known; anandamaya effectively infinite.

nodes.label: Property: Density
nodes.desc: Body dense; prana fluid → the nadis. Subtler koshas progressively less dense.

nodes.label: Wakefulness
nodes.desc: 'How awake are we, really?' Applied layer by layer. Two alarms: the ones we set vs. the ones nature set out of love.

nodes.label: Willpower
nodes.desc: The Anandamaya emphasis of Session 4 — practices that build resolve, chiefly making sankalpas and sticking to them (also tapas, vows).

nodes.label: Sankalpa
nodes.desc: A planted seed of change / resolve set in the quiet states at each layer. Callback across S3→S4; core of willpower work.

nodes.label: Causal introspection
nodes.desc: Tracing anything that troubles or fascinates us inward to its root/causal layer. 'What am I being invited to experience?'

nodes.label: Tapas (austerity / vows)
nodes.desc: Austerity, vows, and sustained resolve — the willpower practices beyond sankalpa named in the Session 4 lesson plan. The friction that forges will and thereby touches Anandamaya.

nodes.label: Cultivating intuition
nodes.desc: Practices to develop Vijnanamaya: feel into the depths, take the larger perspective, advise younger/future self, read sattvic content, Mother Nature.

nodes.label: Sound & Mantra
nodes.desc: OM as first manifest aspect of the unmanifest. Chakra petals = sounds of prana; each Sanskrit letter maps to a nerve 'leaf'. A mantra plays the pranic keyboard of the nervous system.

nodes.label: Collective consciousness
nodes.desc: Where the personal opens into the larger whole; 'phenomena scale at every layer' — microcosm reflects macrocosm.

nodes.label: Tamas
nodes.desc: The guna of inertia/dullness. A quality of what we feed/expose each kosha to.

nodes.label: Rajas
nodes.desc: The guna of activity/agitation. A rajasic/sattvic puppy wakes a tamasic room.

nodes.label: Sattva
nodes.desc: The guna of harmony/clarity. 'Read sattvic content daily from wise humans.'

nodes.label: The Gunas
nodes.desc: Tamas/rajas/sattva as the quality of inputs to each kosha. 'Always read the gunas.' Practices stimulate, tranquilize, or balance — 'algorithms to tune ourselves to any moment.'

nodes.label: Nourishment & lifestyle
nodes.desc: Which lifestyle choices over-expand vs. over-focus each kosha; what nourishes the intuitive dimension.

nodes.label: Imbalance & elements
nodes.desc: Over/under-fed koshas → dysregulation. Elements ↔ koshas as a model: anxiety is airy/mind → antidote is earth/Annamaya (cold showers, gardening).

nodes.label: Whirlpool / Eddy
nodes.desc: 'A whirlpool is not different from water — it IS water — but with a definite form and structure.' The body as a field of energy with definite form. (Jorge's contribution.)

nodes.label: Cloud
nodes.desc: A cloud that stays together through change — image of cohesion against entropy (Annamaya).

nodes.label: Car & Gearbox
nodes.desc: Body+energy = all the parts of the car; the pranic system is the gearbox/transmission — shifting gears on demand to move between situations.

nodes.label: Skilled driver / leopard
nodes.desc: 'I don't drive when the leopards are out — I drive when they sleep; I check the weather.' Anticipation / pattern recognition (Vijnanamaya).

nodes.label: Old car vs new car
nodes.desc: The modern car full of sensors (from the S3 podcast) — sensitivity analogy; a sensing/integration image landed in the S4 integration section.

nodes.label: Photographer's lenses
nodes.desc: A bag of lenses switched per situation — direct awareness fluidly among the koshas.

nodes.label: Software / interface
nodes.desc: Data moves through server/database but you can't see it until you build an interface — the body is the first interface for feeling.

nodes.label: Stream / dam
nodes.desc: Clearing leaf-blocks from a forest stream multiplied the fish — 'we clear the blocks, we increase the flow… conduits for life force, speakers for the music called life.'

nodes.label: The healing monk
nodes.desc: The Buddhist monk Satchidananda lived with — predicted his day to train accuracy; read a hidden elbow injury by extending awareness into the body, 'like their body is my body.'

nodes.label: Fusion energy
nodes.desc: Emotion as intensely powerful, dangerous if uncontained: lab → city → world. 'Don't shut the feeling down — give it the largest, safest container.'

nodes.label: Golden / divine flame
nodes.desc: A steady golden flame at the eyebrow/heart center in the settling practice — image for the inner light at the causal core.

nodes.label: Akashic library
nodes.desc: Image of Vijnanamaya — a library of all that can be known; adepts 'know which floor, which shelf, which book.'

nodes.label: Mother Nature
nodes.desc: The oldest and youngest teacher (~13.8 bn years, yet 'born every moment') — 'anything we have, she already had, and does better.'

nodes.label: The table
nodes.desc: An integration/scanning image for laying the koshas out together — paired with old-vs-new-car in the S4 integration section.

nodes.label: Hatha Yoga
nodes.desc: Works with the physical & energetic (deeper-body, nadi) layers — asana, pranayama, shatkarmas.

nodes.label: Raja Yoga
nodes.desc: Works with the mental dimension (manomaya) — pratyahara, dharana, meditation.

nodes.label: Bhakti Yoga
nodes.desc: Devotion/emotion. Appears 'fourth in the progression', linked to the advanced work of emotional balance — kirtan, japa, Pratipaksha Bhavana.

nodes.label: Karma Yoga
nodes.desc: Seva; watching the ego in interactions.

nodes.label: Jnana Yoga
nodes.desc: Self-inquiry; SWAN (Strengths, Weaknesses, Ambitions, Needs).

nodes.label: Kriya Yoga
nodes.desc: Awakens deep psychic energies; influences all koshas.

nodes.label: Pranayama
nodes.desc: Breath regulation — Kapalabhati, Nadi Shodhana / Anuloma Viloma, Ujjayi, Bhramari. Primary tool for Pranamaya.

nodes.label: Asana
nodes.desc: Postural practice — primary tool for Annamaya. Also body-shaking, palming, Shavasana.

nodes.label: Antarmouna / Pratyahara
nodes.desc: Inner silence; rotating the five senses; sense-withdrawal — attention training for Manomaya.

nodes.label: Shatkarmas
nodes.desc: Cleansing practices — Neti, Kunjal, Shankhaprakshalana, fasting. Annamaya/Pranamaya.

nodes.label: Three mantras
nodes.desc: Mahamrityunjaya → Annamaya+Pranamaya; Gayatri → Manomaya+Vijnanamaya; 32 Names of Durga → Anandamaya. Each with a sankalpa.

nodes.label: Saha Nāvavatu
nodes.desc: Opening peace-invocation (Taittirīya / Kṛṣṇa-Yajurveda): 'May we both be protected and nourished together; may we study with vigour; may our learning be illuminating; may we never quarrel.' The teacher frames it as learning with no hierarchy — teacher and student, and vidyā itself, advancing together.

nodes.label: OM
nodes.desc: The first manifest aspect of the unmanifest. Imagined pervading every kosha and the universe; the bookend of every session's closing.

nodes.label: Journal / Sadhana
nodes.desc: Daily attention/kosha journal charted over the course; per-kosha component list; a guna read of inputs. 'Find the boundaries of your experience.'

nodes.label: Ale (host / translator)
nodes.desc: The host who invited Satchidananda and ran the live Spanish translation across the sessions ('thanking Ale for inviting me'). The reason the opening Saha Nāvavatu — no distinction between teacher and student — is lived, not just recited. Promoted in Stage-2 curation (auto-extractor caught ~26 mentions; the prior hand-pass missed the real person behind them).

nodes.label: Kapalabhati
nodes.desc: Skull-shining rapid-exhalation pranayama — 'the first pranayama being kapalabhati'. A pranic shatkarma/breath used to awaken and move prana; in S3 done rhythmically with body-shaking. A concrete tool of the Pranamaya layer. Promoted in Stage-2 (auto-extractor found 5 mentions across S2/S3 the prior pass folded only generically into 'pranayama').

nodes.label: Chidakash
nodes.desc: The dark inner 'screen' / space of consciousness seen behind closed eyes — 'anything you see in this darkened space that we call Chidakash'. The field of inner perception worked with in the settling/antarmouna practice (palming, awareness behind the eyes). Promoted in Stage-2 (auto-extractor caught 4 mentions; the prior pass had no node for the inner mind-space itself).

nodes.label: Visualization
nodes.desc: The affirmation skill at the heart of S4's mantras: as you make an affirmation (sankalpa), WAKE the emotional feeling of it already coming true AND VISUALIZE that state — 'feel cold when you think cold, start to sweat when you think hot.' It can take years to awaken to full potential, and is a prerequisite for the higher branches (bhakti, kriya yoga). Validated by modern neuroplasticity.

nodes.label: Externalization ↔ Internalization
nodes.desc: Yoga's in-and-out priming: externalization projects awareness outward (sensing the room, another's state, waking each kosha); internalization (pratyahara) draws it inward to the witness and the causal seed. A complete sadhana trains both directions, moving fluidly between them.

nodes.label: Tantra
nodes.desc: Mantra is a tool of Tantra — 'anything that expands consciousness and liberates energy.' It predates yoga (tantric discoveries), and was adopted by yoga and later religions.

nodes.label: Yoga Nidra
nodes.desc: A short, sound-based yoga nidra: complete stillness, the practitioner guided by external (and in advanced stages internal) sound. A vehicle for planting a sankalpa in the quiet state.

nodes.label: Indriyas — sense pathways
nodes.desc: Elements map to sense organs (indriyas) by density: earth->smell, water->taste, fire->sight, air->touch, ether/space->sound; subtlest of all is the mind. Sound, being subtlest, pervades the others — which is why mantra reaches every kosha.

nodes.label: Subconscious & affirmations
nodes.desc: On waking the subconscious is still accessible (dreams slip away with movement); it may drive 70%+ of waking life across the koshas. Positive affirmations planted on waking — reinforced through the day — create a positive feedback loop into it. Why the three mantras are traditionally done instantly on waking (Satyananda tradition).

nodes.label: Neuroplasticity — 'The Brain That Changes Itself'
nodes.desc: Norman Doidge's 'The Brain That Changes Itself' — modern case studies validating the ancient claim that visualization can actually change the body. Cited as evidence for cultivating the imagine-and-feel capacity.

nodes.label: Laghoo Shankhaprakshalana
nodes.desc: The short digestive-cleanse practice. In this session its FIVE asanas were delivered (Tadasana, Tiryaka Tadasana, Kati Chakrasana, Tiryaka Bhujangasana, Udarakarshanasana); the salt-water cleanse itself was omitted. Falls outside the wXDXmb4MMR0 recording, which captures only the opening + mantra portion (ends at the Durga chant ~44:19).
